name: Crawler Leg
summary: Along Darkshore's misty coast, crabs lose legs most travelers have no use for. Their tough limbs can keep a gnome's communication device working.

sections.title: Gnomish Ingenuity on the Coast
sections.body:
Darkshore's crabs leave sturdy legs along the shore, from pygmy tide crawlers to reef crawlers. The night elf sentinels pay them little mind. But gnome engineer Wizbang Cranktoggle has found a use for them.

From Auberdine, he designed prototype long-distance communication devices called buzzboxes to work with improvised local parts. Crawler legs have segmented joints and durable chitin, giving the friction and leverage needed to repair Buzzbox 827 just south of town along the shore.

faq.q: What are crawler legs used for?
faq.answer: Crawler legs help repair Buzzbox 827, an experimental communication station along the Darkshore coast just south of Auberdine. Gnome inventor Wizbang Cranktoggle placed it there.

faq.q: Where do crawler legs come from?
faq.answer: Crawler legs come from crabs along Darkshore's beaches. These include Pygmy Tide Crawlers, Young Reef Crawlers, Encrusted Tide Crawlers, and Reef Crawlers.

faq.q: Why does a mechanical buzzbox need crab legs?
aliases: how does crawler leg fix buzzbox
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle designed his machines to use parts from nearby wildlife for field repairs. Crawler legs have rigid joints and chitinous segments that fit the buzzbox's grinding gears and restore its mechanisms.

angles.text: Wizbang Cranktoggle uses crab legs as makeshift levers, showing how gnomes improvise in the field with nearby materials in place of standard metal linkages.
As a gnome, you may see aggressive crustaceans on a beach and recognize their legs as possible parts for a delicate long-distance communication network.
